Mo se faataitaiga: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ina ia faamisi mataitusi pule tasi (' \/), e mafai ona faaaoga \. Mo se faataitaiga: Field1 == I\'m. E mafai foi ona tuufaatasi ni aiaiga se tele. Mo se faataitaiga: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. E masani ona faamatalaina faagaoioiga uma mai le agavale i le taumatau. E mafai ona sui le faasologa i le tuuina o puipui. Mo se faataitaiga: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). E mafai foi ona saili fanua tusitusiga i le regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Faapipii se JSON auina atu a Kanboard: se mea faitino e iai "columns" (po o galuega o loo iai column_name) ma se faasologa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). E avea columns ma lisi ma tasks ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-deck: Faapipii se JSON o le laupapa NextCloud Deck (se laupapa e iai "stacks", ma stacks taitasi e iai ana "cards"). E avea stacks ma lisi ma cards ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Faapipii se JSON o le aoina o work-packages a OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). E avea statuses ma lisi ma work packages ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-issues: Faapipii se faasologa JSON o issues a __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). E avea issues ma pepa ua faavasega i lisi Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Faapipii se JSON auina atu o tasks a Asana ({ "data": [...] } mai le auina atu a Asana po o GET /tasks). E faavasega tasks i sections (memberships); o tasks ua maea e alu i Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Faapipii se JSON auina atu o le lisi ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). E avea stages ma lisi ma items ma pepa.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Pipii se lisi galuega markdown (masani lea o loʻo faʻaaogaina e meafaigaluega markdown-kanban e pei o le Obsidian Kanban): ulutala "## Igoa o le lisi", faatasi ai ma mea "- [ ]"/"- [x]" i lalo. E avea ulutala ma lisi ma avea mea ma kata.
import-board-instruction-leo: Faapipii se fausaga Leo (se faila .leo). O vaega i le tulaga pito i luga e avea ma lisi, o vaega o loo i lalo tonu o ia vaega e avea ma pepa, ma o tusitusiga o le vaega e avea ma faamatalaga o le pepa. O vaega i tulaga e sili atu ona loloto e avea ma lisi siaki. O vaega ua faailogaina e aumai o ni vaega ua maea.
import-board-instruction-opml: Faapipii se otootoga OPML, e pei ona auina atu e Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ma isi polokalame otootoga. O mea i le tulaga pito i luga e avea ma lisi, o a latou fanau e avea ma pepa ma le faamatalaga o le faamatalaga o le pepa, ma o mea e sili ona loloto e avea ma lisi siaki. O mea ua maea e faaulufale o ni mea ua maea.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Faapipii se faila Org mode, e pei ona tusia e Emacs, Orgzly po o Beorg. O ulutala i le tulaga pito i luga e avea ma lisi ma o ulutala i le tulaga lona lua e avea ma pepa. E teu pea TODO ma DONE, faamuamua, faailoga, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ma CLOSED, ma o pusa siaki ma ulutala e sili ona loloto e avea ma lisi siaki.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Faapipii se faila todo.txt: tasi le galuega i laina ta'itasi, e pei ona tusia e le polokalame todo.txt ma isi polokalame e fetaui i ai. O galuega ua mae'a ("x") e alu i le vaega Ua mae'a, o +project ma @context e avea ma faailoga, o (A) e avea ma faailoga o le faamuamua, ae o due: ma t: e avea ma aso e tatau ona mae'a ai ma aso e amata ai.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Faapipii le iʻuga o le task export: se faasologa JSON po o se galuega e tasi i laina taʻitasi. O galuega ua maeʻa e alu i Done, project ma priority e avea ma igoa faailoga, annotations e avea ma faamatalaga, ma depends e avea ma faalagolago i galuega o loo poloka ai.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Tatala le faila .boardarchive mai le zip ma faapipii le anotusi o le board.jsonl o le laupapa, faatasi ma le laina o le lomiga pe aunoa ma lea laina. O le uiga e tuufaatasi ai vaega i le vaaiga o le laupapa e avea ma lisi, o isi uiga filifilia e avea ma igoa faailoga, o poloka o tusitusiga ma pusa faailoga e avea ma faamatalaga ma se lisi siaki, ma e teu pea manatu faaalia. E lē faaulufaleina ata ma faila faaopoopo.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: I le MeisterTask, oomi le igoa o le poloketi, filifili Export project ma auina atu le CSV, ona faapipii lea. O vaega e avea ma lisi ma o galuega e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma a latou faamatalaga, aso e tatau ai, tagata tofia ma faailoga; o galuega ua maea e teu pea lo latou aso na maea ai. E aoga foi se CSV na tusia mo le faaulufale a MeisterTask lava ia.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: I le Obsidian, tatala le faila o le laupapa Kanban o se Markdown (pe tatala le faila .md i se faatonu tusitusiga), ona faapipii uma lea. O ala e avea ma lisi faatasi ma a latou tapulaa o pepa, o pepa e teu pea a latou faailoga, aso, faamuamua, fanua ma lisi siaki, ma o le Archive e avea ma pepa ua teuina.
import-board-instruction-linear: I le Linear, auina atu issues o se CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, po o le auina atu o se vaaiga), ona faapipii lea o le CSV. O tulaga e avea ma lisi, o au e avea ma ala, ma o issues e avea ma pepa faatasi ma lo latou tagata tofia, igoa faailoga, aso, issue matua, faamuamua, fuafuaga, poloketi ma taamilosaga.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: I le TickTick, tatala Settings, Account, Backup & Import ma fausia se kopi faasao, ona faapipii lea o le faila CSV. O lisi taitasi a TickTick e avea ma ala ma ona koluma e avea ma lisi; o galuega e teu pea a latou faailoga, aso, lisi siaki, faamuamua ma galuega laiti.
import-board-instruction-clickup: I le ClickUp, auina atu galuega o se CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, po o le auina atu o se vaaiga List po o Table ma koluma uma), ona faapipii lea o le CSV. O tulaga e avea ma lisi, o lisi a ClickUp e avea ma ala, ma o galuega e avea ma pepa faatasi ma a latou galuega laiti, tagata tofia, faailoga, aso, faamuamua ma taimi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: I le Nullboard, tatala le laupapa, filifili Export this board... mai le lisi o filifiliga, tatala le faila .nbx i se faatonu tusitusiga ma faapipii ona anotusi. O lisi e avea ma lisi ma o faamatalaga e avea ma pepa: o le laina muamua o se faamatalaga o le ulutala o le pepa ma o le vaega o totoe o lona faamatalaga. O se faamatalaga raw e maua le igoa faailoga raw. O se faila e tele laupapa e faaulufale lona laupapa muamua.
import-board-instruction-kanri: I le Kanri, tatala Import & Export ma filifili Export individual board (po o Export all data), ona faapipii lea o le faila .json. O koluma e avea ma lisi ma o pepa e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma a latou faamatalaga, aso e tatau ai, faailoga ma lanu; o galuega a se pepa e avea ma lisi siaki. Mai se auina atu o faamatalaga uma, e faaulufale le laupapa muamua.
import-board-instruction-planka: Tusi le tuatusi o lau Planka (faataitaiga https://planka.example.com), lou igoa o le tagata faaaoga ma le upu faataga o Planka, ona oomi lea o le «Faaali mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu». E faaaoga na o le aumaia o le laupapa ma e le teuina. Filifili se laupapa ma oomi le «Aumai»: e faitau e WeKan mai le API a Planka faatasi ma ona lisi, pepa, faamatalaga, aso e tatau ai, igoa faailoga, sui, lisi o galuega ma manatu, ona faaauau lea o le aumaia i totonu e pei ona masani ai. O pepa i le teuina a Planka e aumai i totonu o ni mea ua teuina; e le aumaia faapipii ma pepa i le pusa lapisi.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: I le Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), saini i totonu, ioe i le faatagaga Tasks.Read ma kopi le token mai le itulau Access token. Faapipii iinei ma oomi le «Faaali mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu»; e faaaoga le token mo lenei aumaiga na o ia ma e le teuina. Filifili lisi uma pe tasi ma oomi le «Aumai». O lisi uma o To Do e avea ma lisi ma galuega uma e avea ma pepa, faatasi ai ma faamatalaga, aso e tatau ai ma aso amata, laasaga o se lisi siaki, vaega o ni igoa faailoga, taua maualuga ma tulaga o ni igoa faailoga; o galuega ua uma e teuina. E le aumaia faamanatu ma toe faia.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: I le KanbanFlow, tatala le lisi o filifiliga a le laupapa, filifili Settings → API & Webhooks ma kopi le token API a le laupapa. Faapipii le token iinei, oomi le «Faaali mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu», filifili le laupapa ma oomi le «Aumai»; e faaaoga le token mo lena aumaiga na o ia ma e le teuina. O koluma e avea ma lisi ma ala e tumau pea o ala; e taofi e galuega a latou faamatalaga, lanu, igoa faailoga, aso e tatau ai, galuega laiti o se lisi siaki, taimi na faaaogaina, fuafuaga, tagata ma manatu.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Tusi le ID o lau teugatupe Basecamp (o le numera i le maeʻa o basecamp.com/ i le tuatusi) ma se token ulufale (mai se app OAuth 2 ua resitalaina i launchpad.37signals.com, po o se tasi ua i ai i se tuufaatasiga o loo i ai), oomi le «Faaali mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu», filifili se poloketi ma oomi le «Aumai». E faaaoga le token mo lena aumaiga na o ia ma e le teuina. O laulau pepa taitasi e avea ma ala ma ona koluma o ni lisi, ma o lisi o mea e fai e avea ma ala «To-dos»; e taofi e pepa ma mea e fai a latou tusitusiga, aso, tagata ua tofia ma manatu, o laasaga o se pepa e avea ma lisi siaki, ma o mea ua uma e teuina.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Maua se token ulufale mai le OAuth 2.0 Playground: i lalo o Tasks API v1 filifili tasks.readonly, oomi Authorize APIs, ona sosoo ai lea ma Exchange authorization code for tokens, ma kopi le token ulufale. Faapipii iinei ma oomi le «Faaali mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu», filifili lisi uma o galuega pe tasi, ona «Aumai» lea. E faaaoga le token mo lenei aumaiga na o ia ma e le teuina. O lisi o galuega e avea ma lisi ma galuega e avea ma pepa, faatasi ai ma faamatalaga, sootaga ma aso e tatau ai; o galuega laiti e avea ma lisi siaki ma o galuega ua uma e aumai i totonu ua teuina.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: O le API a Google Keep e mo na o teugatupe Google Workspace. Maua se token ulufale OAuth 2.0 ma le lautele https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (i le OAuth 2.0 Playground pe a faataga e lau pule o le Workspace, po o se teugatupe auaunaga e iai le tuuina atu i le vaega atoa), faapipii, oomi le «Faaali mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu» ona «Aumai» lea. E faaaoga le token mo lenei aumaiga na o ia ma e le teuina. O faamatalaga tusitusi e avea ma pepa i le lisi «Notes», ma faamatalaga lisi siaki e avea ma pepa i le lisi «Lists» ma a latou mea o se lisi siaki. E le aumaia faamatalaga i le pusa lapisi, faapipii ma le faasoaina.
api-import-desc: Aumai mai le auaunaga i lau lava teugatupe. O mea e te tusia iinei e faaaoga mo lenei aumaiga na o ia ma e le teuina.
api-import-list: Faaali mea e mafai ona aumai i totonu
api-import-fetched: Ua aumaia. Siaki sui o loo i lalo ma aumai i totonu.
api-import-nothing: E leai se mea e aumai i totonu i lenei teugatupe.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: I le Pivotal Tracker, tatala le itulau MORE o le poloketi ma filifili Export CSV (pe filifili tala ma filifili Bulk Actions, CSV), ona faapipii lea o le CSV. O tulaga taitasi o se tala e avea ma lisi ma o tala e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma lo latou ituaiga ma igoa faailoga, e ona, tagata na talosaga, aso, faamatalaga, galuega ma mea e poloka ai; o Estimate e avea ma Story points ma o iterations e avea ma sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: I le Tasks.org, tatala Settings, Backups ma filifili Export tasks, ona faapipii lea o anotusi o lena faila .json. O lisi e avea ma lisi ma o galuega e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma a latou faamatalaga, faailoga, aso, manatu ma galuega laiti; o galuega ua maea e teu pea lo latou aso na maea ai, ma o le faamuamua e avea ma fanua patino.
import-board-instruction-monday: I le monday.com, tatala le lisi o filifiliga a le laupapa, filifili More actions ma Export board to Excel (faatasi ma updates ma subitems pe a e manao), ona filifili lea o lena faila .xlsx. O le koluma Status e avea ma lisi ma o vaega e avea ma ala; o tagata, aso, laina taimi ma faailoga e tumau i o latou nofoaga, o isi koluma e avea ma fanua patino ma o updates e avea ma faamatalaga.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: I le Super Productivity, tatala Settings, ona sosoo ai lea ma Sync & Backup, filifili Export Data ma faapipii anotusi o le faila sp-backup .json. O poloketi taitasi e avea ma ala ma o galuega e avea ma pepa i le To Do, In Progress, Backlog po o Done, faatasi ma a latou faamatalaga, faailoga, aso e tatau ai, taimi na faaaogaina ma galuega laiti; o galuega ua teuina e avea ma pepa ua teuina.
import-board-instruction-taiga: I le Taiga, tatala Admin > Project > Export ma sii mai le kopi atoa o le poloketi (tatala muamua se faila .json.gz), ona faapipii lea o lona JSON. O tulaga o user story e avea ma lisi, o user stories e avea ma pepa ma a latou galuega o ni galuega laiti, o epics ma issues e maua a latou lava ala, ma e aumai faatasi sprints, faailoga, faamatalaga ma uiga patino. E le faaulufale faapipii.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: I le Vikunja, tatala Settings, filifili Data Export ma sii mai le faila .zip e auina mai ia te oe, ona filifili lea o lena faila, pe faapipii le data.json i totonu. O buckets Kanban e avea ma lisi ma o galuega e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma a latou igoa faailoga, tagata tofia, aso, faamatalaga, lisi o galuega o ni lisi siaki ma manatu; o le faamuamua, pasene ua maea ma ua maea e avea ma fanua patino. E le faaulufale faapipii.
import-board-instruction-quire: I le Quire, tatala le lisi o filifiliga a le poloketi ma filifili Export CSV, ona faapipii lea o le CSV. O tulaga e avea ma lisi ma o galuega e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma a latou galuega laiti o ni pepa fanau, tagata tofia, faailoga o ni igoa faailoga, aso amata, aso e tatau ai ma aso ua maea, faamatalaga ma le faamuamua o se fanua patino. E le o iai faamatalaga ma faapipii i le CSV a Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: I le Wrike, auina atu se poloketi po o se faila i le Excel, pe faatumu le faataitaiga faaulufale Excel a Wrike, ona filifili lea o lena faila .xlsx. O laina o faila ma poloketi e avea ma ala, o Status e avea ma lisi ma o galuega e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma lo latou Key, galuega matua, tagata tofia, aso amata ma aso faaiu, faalagolago ma faamatalaga; o Priority, Duration ma isi koluma e avea ma fanua patino.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: I le Teamwork.com, faatumu le faataitaiga faaulufale galuega Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ma teu o se .xlsx, ona filifili lea o lena faila. O lisi o galuega e avea ma lisi ma o galuega e avea ma pepa; o se galuega e amata i le -, # po o le > e avea ma galuega laiti o le galuega i luga atu (--, ## po o >> tasi le tulaga e loloto atu). O tagata tofia, aso ma faailoga e tumau i o latou nofoaga; o Priority, Estimated time ma Complete e avea ma fanua patino.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: I le Businessmap (sa taua muamua o Kanbanize), tatala Advanced Search, filifili Configure results e filifili ai koluma, sii mai le faila Excel, ona filifili lea o lena faila .xlsx. E faitau koluma i o latou igoa Igilisi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): afai e faaaoga e lau teugatupe se isi gagana, toe faaigoa muamua le laina ulutala i le Igilisi. O Column e avea ma lisi ma o Lane ma ala; o e ona, faailoga, lanu, aso, faamatalaga ma sootaga matua e tumau i o latou nofoaga, ma o Priority, Size, Type ma isi koluma e avea ma fanua patino.
import-board-instruction-redmine: I le Redmine, tatala Issues a le poloketi, filifili Also available in: CSV i le pito i lalo o le lisi, filifili koluma (All columns, ma Description) ma auina atu, ona faapipii lea o le CSV. E faaigoa e Redmine koluma i lau gagana, o lea seti lau gagana i le Igilisi i le My account a o lei auina atu. O tulaga taitasi e avea ma lisi ma o issues e avea ma pepa, faatasi ma le tracker o se igoa faailoga, tagata tofia, tusitala, aso, galuega matua ma issues fesootai; o le faamuamua, vaega, lomiga faamoemoeina, taimi fuafuaina, % Done ma fanua patino e avea ma fanua patino.
import-board-instruction-notion: I le Notion, tatala le database o se itulau atoa, filifili ••• ma Export, filifili Markdown & CSV, ma filifili le faila .zip e sii mai, po o se tasi CSV database mai ai, pe faapipii lena CSV. O se koluma e igoa Status e avea ma lisi (afai e leai, o le koluma muamua e foliga o se filifiliga, ma e taua e le lipoti faaulufale po o fea); o laina e avea ma pepa faatasi ma lo latou ulutala, faailoga o ni igoa faailoga, tagata o ni sui, aso, ma tusitusiga o le itulau o le faamatalaga; o isi koluma e avea ma fanua patino. E le faaulufale sootaga, ata ma faapipii.
import-board-instruction-plane: I le Plane, tatala Workspace Settings, filifili Exports, auina atu poloketi o se JSON, CSV po o Excel ma sii mai le faila .zip, ona filifili lea o lena faila, po o se faila e tasi mai totonu, pe faapipii le JSON po o le CSV. O tulaga e avea ma lisi, o poloketi e avea ma ala, ma o issues e avea ma pepa faatasi ma lo latou faailoga, matua, tagata tofia, igoa faailoga, aso, sootaga ma faamatalaga; o le faamuamua, fuafuaga, taamilosaga ma module e avea ma fanua patino. E leai ni faamatalaga po o ni faapipii i le auina atu a Plane, o lea e le faaulufale ai.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - pepa o loo avea ai *<username>* ma *sui* po o *lē ua tofia*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-membe: `__operator_member__:<username>` - pepa o loo avea ai *<username>* ma *sui*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - pepa e auai i se laupapa ua tofia i le au *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - pepa e tatau ona mae'a i totonu o le *<n>* aso mai le taimi nei. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ e lisi ai pepa uma ua te'a o latou aso e tatau ai.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - pepa na faia i le *<n>* aso talu ai po o se taimi puupuu atu
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - pepa na suia i le *<n>* aso talu ai po o se taimi puupuu atu

globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - pepa uma ua teuina ma e lei teuina
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - pepa e iai se aso faaiu
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - na o pepa i laupapa lautele
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - na o pepa i laupapa patino
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - o le *<field>* o se tasi o `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` po o `__predicate_member__`. O le tuuina o le `-` i luma o le *<field>* e saili ai le leai o se tau i lena fanua (faataitaiga `has:-due` e saili ai pepa e leai se aso e tatau ai).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - o le *<sort-name>* o se tasi o `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` po o `__predicate_modified__`. Mo se faavasegaga e alu ifo, tuu le `-` i luma o le igoa o le faavasegaga.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - o le *<n>* o se numera atoa lelei e faailoa ai le aofaiga o pepa e faaali i itulau taitasi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: E mafai ona faamaoti ni faagaoioi se tele.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
O faagaoioi tutusa e tuufaatasia i le *OR*. E toe faafoi pepa e fetaui ma soo se tuutuuga.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` e toe faafoi pepa o loo i soo se lisi e igoa *Blocked* po o *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: O faagaoioi eseese e tuufaatasia i le *AND*. E na o pepa e fetaui ma faagaoioi eseese uma e toe faafoi. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` e toe faafoi na o pepa i le lisi *Available* e iai le igoa faailoga *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: E mafai ona faamaoti aso i se numera atoa lelei po o le lelei-lēai, pe faaaoga `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` po o `__predicate_year__` mo le vaitaimi o loo iai nei.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: E lē amanaia e sailiga tusitusiga mataitusi tetele ma mataitusi laiti.

render-links-as-plain-text: Faaali sootaga o ni tusitusiga masani
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Pe a mafai, o sootaga uma (sootaga markdown e pei o [label](url) ma pine HTML mata <a href>) e faaali pea o ni tusitusiga masani e lē mafai ona kiliki i fanua tusitusiga teuteu uma (ulutala o laupapa ma pepa, faamatalaga auiliili, faamatalaga, lisi siaki, ma isi). E taofia ai sootaga kiliki e taufaasese. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu, o lea e mafai pea ona kiliki sootaga.
always-show-code-as-text: Faaali pea code uma o ni tusitusiga masani
always-show-code-as-text-description: Pe a mafai, e lē faaliliuina lava tusitusiga teuteu o se markdown po o HTML: e faaali pea le puna atoa o ni tusitusiga masani i fanua tusitusiga teuteu uma (ulutala o laupapa ma pepa, faamatalaga auiliili, faamatalaga, lisi siaki, ma isi). E faaalia ai anotusi nana — faamatalaga HTML (<!-- -->), le taulaiga o sootaga markdown, JavaScript ma soo se isi code — ina ia vaaia pea code uma, e lē mafai ona kiliki, ma e lē faagaoioia. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu, o lea e faaliliuina masani ai le markdown.
disable-all-import-description: Pe a mafai, e tape tomai uma e aumai ai: aumaia o se laupapa mai WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ma Forgejo, faapea le kopiina o se laupapa. E nana filifiliga o le lisi aumai ma e teena e le sapalai soo se talosaga e aumai. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-all-export-description: Pe a mafai, e tape tomai uma e auina atu ai: auina atu o se laupapa o WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, po o le auina i NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ma le auina atu o se faapipii e tasi. E nana filifiliga o le lisi auina atu ma e teena e le sapalai soo se talosaga e auina atu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-import-avatars: Tape le aumaia o ata o tagata
disable-import-avatars-description: Pe a mafai, e lē aumaia lava ata o tagata (ata o talaaga o tagata faaaoga). E aofia ai le aumaia o WeKan JSON, le aumaia o Trello, ma le faafetaui o ata mai auaunaga faailoa i fafo pe a ulufale (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). E aumai pea igoa ma isi faamatalaga; na o ata o tagata e faamisi. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-export-avatars: Tape le auina atu o ata o tagata
disable-export-avatars-description: Pe a mafai, e lē aofia lava ata o tagata (ata o talaaga o tagata faaaoga) pe a auina atu se laupapa (auina atu WeKan JSON ma CSV). E auina atu pea igoa o tagata faaaoga ma isi faamatalaga; na o ata o tagata e aveese. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
anonymize-import-users: Aveese faailoaga o tagata faaaoga e aumai
anonymize-import-users-description: Pe a mafai, o le aumaia o se laupapa WeKan JSON e sui ai igoa o tagata faaaoga, igoa atoa ma mataitusi amata o tagata uma ua aumai i mea suitulaga faitau (user1, user2, ...), aveese a latou ata, ma toe tusia ta'ua @username (ma fanua requested-by / assigned-by) i totonu o anotusi o pepa ma faamatalaga ua aumai. E leai se faailoaga moni o se tagata faaaoga mai le laupapa puna e teuina. O le upu "tagata faaaoga" e mulimuli i le gagana a le tagata o loo aumaia. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
anonymize-export-users: Aveese faailoaga o tagata faaaoga e auina atu
anonymize-export-users-description: Pe a mafai, o le auina atu o se laupapa e sui ai igoa o tagata faaaoga, igoa atoa ma mataitusi amata o tagata uma ua auina atu i mea suitulaga faitau (user1, user2, ...), aveese a latou ata, ma toe tusia ta'ua @username (ma fanua requested-by / assigned-by) i totonu o anotusi o pepa ma faamatalaga. E leai se faailoaga moni o se tagata faaaoga i le faila ua auina atu. O le upu "tagata faaaoga" e mulimuli i le gagana a le tagata o loo auina atu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
anonymize-account: Aveese faailoaga o tagata faaaoga e aumai
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Pe a mafai, o le auina atu o se laupapa e sui ai igoa o tagata faaaoga, igoa atoa ma mataitusi amata o tagata uma ua auina atu i mea suitulaga faitau (user1, user2, ...), aveese a latou ata, ma toe tusia ta'ua @username (ma fanua requested-by / assigned-by) i totonu o anotusi o pepa ma faamatalaga. E leai se faailoaga moni o se tagata faaaoga i le faila ua auina atu. O le upu "tagata faaaoga" e mulimuli i le gagana a le tagata o loo auina atu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-activities-description: Pe a mafai, e lē faamauina lava ma e lē faaalia i soo se mea faamaumauga o le fafaga o gaoioiga (itu lisi o le laupapa ma le laupepa gaoioiga o le pepa). E leai se talafaasolopito o ai na faia le ā e teuina. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-notifications-description: Pe a mafai, e lē auina atu lava e WeKan faasilasilaga mataitu (i totonu o le polokalama, imeli po o isi auaunaga) mo soo se gaoioiga. E mafai pea ona faamauina gaoioiga (seia vagana ua tape foi i luga); na o faasilasilaga e taofia. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
disable-watch-description: Pe a mafai, e tape le tomai mataitu — e lē mafai e tagata faaaoga ona lesitala i laupapa, lisi po o pepa e maua ai faasilasilaga, ma e teena soo se taumafaiga e suia se tulaga mataitu. E tape i le tulaga faaletonu.
backup-description: Fai kopi faaleoleo o Faapipii, Ata o Tagata ma/po o Faamatalaga (faaputuga tusitusia uma e lē o ni faapipii po o ni ata o tagata). E tafe sa'o le .zip i le nofoaga teu filifilia — e leai se faila lē tumau — o backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, e aofia ai YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ma /data. O nofoaga teu i le ao (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) e faaaoga faamaoniga ua faatulaga i a latou laupepa teu.
backup-scope-description: O le faiga atoa, po o se Faalapotopotoga e tasi. O le kopi faaleoleo a se Faalapotopotoga e aofia ai ana laupapa ma mea uma o iai, e aofia ai faapipii o na laupapa — ae leai ni teugatupe a tagata faaaoga po o faatulagaga o le faiga, aua e faasoa na mea e Faalapotopotoga uma. O le toe faafoiina o le kopi faaleoleo a se Faalapotopotoga e na o laupapa e ana le Faalapotopotoga e tusia ai.
theme-override-all-tenants: Suiga e faaaoga i tagata nofoia uma
continuous-backup-description: E lafo suiga uma o le nofoaga o faamatalaga, faapipii, ata o tagata ma faamaumauga o galuega i se faila i totonu o ni sekone, ina ia mafai ona toe faafoi i soo se taimi. E galulue faatasi ma le kopi faaleoleo faatulagaina, lea e faia ai kopi atoa.
continuous-backup-enabled: Fai kopi faaleoleo faifai pea i lenei seva
continuous-backup-target: Faila e teu ai (ala atoa, i se isi tisiki, se nofoaga fefaasoaaʻi i le fesootaiga po o se nofoaga ua faapipii i le rclone)
continuous-backup-engine: Afi o le nofoaga o faamatalaga
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (i le taimi lava lea, suiga uma)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Itulau SQLite (itulau ua suia i taimi taitasi ua faatulagaina)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (polokalame e mafai ona e faapipii pe a e finagalo i ai)
continuous-backup-engine-none: E leai se afi o le nofoaga o faamatalaga e mafai ona galue i lenei seva
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Taimi i le va o galuega SQLite (sekone)
continuous-backup-base-every: Fai se kopi faavae fou i itūlā taitasi ua faatulagaina
continuous-backup-encrypt: Faailoga le kopi faaleoleo i se tulafono faalilolilo (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Faila o le ki mo le faailoga faalilolilo (ala atoa i fafo o le faila e teu ai; mataitusi e 64 o le faiga numera faavae 16 po o se fuaitau faalilolilo e lē itiiti ifo i le 16 mataitusi). Teu se kopi: a leai lenei faila, e lē mafai ona toe faafoi le kopi faaleoleo.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Leai se nofoaga (na o le faila e teu ai)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Faila i totonu o le pakete e teu ai
continuous-backup-fetched: Ua aumai faila mai le ao
continuous-backup-restore-to: Toe faafoi i (aso ma le taimi)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Faila o le nofoaga o faamatalaga SQLite (e fausia i autafa o le kopi faaleoleo, e lē tusia lava i luga o le faila o loo faaaogā)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Faaaogā le nofoaga o faamatalaga SQLite ua toe fausia i le isi toe amataga (e teu pea le nofoaga tuai o faamatalaga ua suia)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Toe faafoi le augatupulaga ua filifilia i le taimi ua filifilia? E taofi lē tumau le kopi faaleoleo faifai pea a o faagasolo le toe faafoi.
continuous-backup-saved: Ua sefe faatulagaga o kopi faaleoleo faifai pea
backup-restore-add-missing: Faaopoopo na o faamatalaga o loo misi
backup-restore-select-first: Filifili muamua se kopi faaleoleo mai le lisi.
backup-restore-confirm: Toe faafoi le kopi faaleoleo filifilia? E tusia faapipii/ata o tagata i le faiga faila ma faamatalaga i le nofoaga o faamatalaga e tusa ma le faiga filifilia.
gcs-key-filename: Ala o le faila ki o le teugatupe tautua
gcs-key-filename-description: Filifiliga: ala i se faila ki JSON o le teugatupe tautua i luga o le sapalai.
gcs-credentials-description: Filifiliga: faapipii le ki JSON o le teugatupe tautua. Tuu gaogao e faaaoga ai le faila ki po o faamaoniga faaletonu.
gcs-permissions-note: Tuu atu i le teugatupe tautua a WeKan le avanoa faitau/tusi i le pakete: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → lau pakete → Permissions → Grant access. I le "New principals", faapipii le imeli o le teugatupe tautua — le tau "client_email" mai lau ki JSON — ona filifili lea o le matafaioi "Storage Object Admin" ma Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Tuu gaogao e tausia ai le tau o loo iai nei.
azure-account-name-description: Le igoa o lau teugatupe Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Le koneteina blob e teu ai faila.
gcs-project-id-description: Le id o lau poloketi Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Le igoa o le pakete Cloud Storage e teu ai faila.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: tuu gaogao (e faaaoga le nofoaga faaiu o le itulagi). E fetaui ma S3: le Endpoint URL mai lau faamafanafanaga MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → lau pakete → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → igoa o lau pakete (po o Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → lau tagata faaaoga → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → filifili le faaaogaina 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. E faaali o le 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: O le lau lava lea e iai le Access key ID; e na o le tasi le taimi e faaali ai le 'Secret access key' pe a faia le ki — kopi i lena taimi (po o Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → igoa e faaali i luga (e iai foi i Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → lau teugatupe → Data storage → Containers → lau koneteina (po o + Container e faia ai se tasi).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → filifiliga o le poloketi i luga → ID o lau poloketi (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → igoa o lau pakete (po o Create e faia ai se tasi).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Ala i luga o le sapalai WeKan i le faila ki JSON o le teugatupe tautua ua sii mai (na faia i lalo). Faaaoga lenei mea PO O le faapipii o le JSON i le fanua i lalo.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → lau teugatupe tautua → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (e sii mai ai le faila). Faapipii lona anotusi iinei, po o le sefe o le faila ma faatulaga lona ala i luga.

cloud-settings-save-failed: Ua lē mafai ona sefe faatulagaga o le nofoaga teu

attachment-move-storage-gcs: Siitia le faapipii i Google Cloud Storage

migration-paused: Ua manuia le taofia mo sina taimi o siitaga

migration-started: Ua manuia le amataina o siitaga

migration-stopped: Ua manuia le taofia o siitaga

s3-bucket-description: Igoa o le pakete S3 mo le teuina o faila

delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Soloi ma le saogalemu lisi gaogao ua faaluaina. E na o lisi e leai ni pepa MA e iai se isi lisi e tutusa le ulutala ma e iai ni pepa e aveese.

run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: O le a muamua liua ai lisi faasoa i lisi mo ala taitasi, ona soloia lea o lisi gaogao e iai se lisi faaluaina e tutusa le ulutala ma e iai ni pepa. E na o lisi gaogao e moni lava e lē manaomia e aveese. Faaauau?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: O le a faia ai se ala 'Pepa ua Leiloa' ma toe faafoi pepa ma lisi uma o loo misi le swimlaneId po o le listId. E na o mea e lei teuina e aafia ai. Faaauau?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: O le a toe faafoi ai ala, lisi ma pepa UMA ua teuina ma toe faaali mai. E faaleleia otometi soo se mea e misi ona IDs. E lē faigofie ona toe faafoi lenei gaoioiga. Faaauau?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: O le a maua ma toe faaleleia ai lisi o loo misi po o ua faaleagaina i le fausaga o le laupapa. Faaauau?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: O le a faafou ai URL o ata o sui o le laupapa e faaaoga ai le faiga teu i tua sa'o. Faaauau?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: O le a faafou ai URL uma o faapipii faila i lenei laupapa e faaaoga ai le faiga teu i tua sa'o. Faaauau?

sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Ua maea ma ni fanua ua le aofia pe ua liua

sync-recovery-description: Lipoti Sync ua teuina mai aso e 30 talu ai. Saili i le ID o le laupapa po o le lisi. O se iuga e lei maea atonu o loo faagasolo pea pe na faalavelaveina. Faafou e toe siaki; e le mafai e nei lipoti ona faaauau pe toe faaleaoga suiga.
sync-recovery-unavailable: E le mafai ona faitau suesuega Sync. Siaki le ulufale a le pule ma le avanoa o le server.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Filifili se fanua numera e iai le ID o le fanua Jira ma le iunite o le fuafuaga, e pei ona fausia e se faaulufale Jira ua faafesootaiina. O suiga i le lotoifale e iloiloina o ni feteenaiga. O tau o le puna e misi e le amanaia; o se null manino e faamama ai le tau ua faafesootaiina.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Vaega mo le fua faatatau i lenei laupapa
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: E tusia le mamafa po o le fua faatatau o le taimi a GitLab i le vaega mo numera ua e filifilia. E iloilo suiga i le lotoifale o ni feteenaʻiga; o se mataupu e leai sona mamafa e tape ai le tau ua fesootaʻi i ai.
email-recovery-heading: Lisi faatalitali mo le auina atu o imeli
email-recovery-description: E tasi le laina mo tagata taʻitasi e mauaina. Suʻe i le ID o le tagata faaaogā. E lē faaalia mataupu o feʻau ma vaega o le imeli a le tagata e mauaina. O le taofi mo sina taimi e taofia feʻau o loo iai ma feʻau o le a oo mai; o le faaauau e toe taumafai loa e auina atu feʻau o loo faatalitali. O le faalēaogā e aveese feʻau na tuu i le lisi seʻia oo i le taimi o le talosaga. Afai o loo faagasolo le auina atu, toe taumafai i se taimi lata mai. E lē mafai ona toe aumai se feʻau ua amata ona auina atu, ma e ono toe auina atu se feʻau e lē mautinoa lona taunuu. E tumau faaletonu tumau ma feʻau ua oo i le tapulaa o taumafaiga mo le toe iloiloina. O le toe taumafai i feʻau na lē manuia e amata ai se taamilosaga fou o taumafaiga ma e tausisia le taofi mo sina taimi ua iai.
email-recovery-saving: O loo faafou le lisi o imeli…
email-recovery-attempts: Aofaʻi aupito maualuga o taumafaiga toe fai
email-recovery-oldest: Taimi muamua na tuu ai i le lisi
email-recovery-changed: Suiga mulimuli a le tagata e faagaoioia

email-recovery-pending: O loo faatalitali pe toe taumafai
email-recovery-empty: E leai ni feʻau o loo faatalitali ma e leai ni tagata ua taofi mo sina taimi le auina atu iā i latou.
email-recovery-unavailable: E lē mafai ona faitau le lisi o imeli. Siaki faatagaga a le pule ma pe o avanoa le seva.

email-recovery-failed: E leʻi mafai ona faamaonia le galuega. Faafou le lisi ma toe taumafai i le gaoioiga lava lea pe a manaʻomia.
email-recovery-superseded: Ua suia lenei talosaga e se gaoioiga fou a le tagata e faagaoioia. O loo faaalia le tulaga o le lisi i le taimi nei.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Faalēaogā feʻau uma o loo faatalitali i le taimi nei mo lenei tagata e mauaina? O le a aveese o latou mataupu ma e lē mafai ona toe maua. E teu pea feʻau fou na faia ina ua uma lenei talosaga.
email-recovery-stopped: Feʻau ua taofia le auina atu
email-recovery-retry: Toe taumafai e auina atu feʻau na lē manuia
email-failure-smtp-authentication: E manaomia le gauai i le faamaoniga o meli
email-failure-smtp-configuration: E manaomia le gauai i le faatulagaga o meli
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: E le maua le tagata e mauaina pe ua tapuni le teugatupe
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: E le mafai ona faamaonia le tuuina atu; iloilo a o lei toe taumafai
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: E le mafai ona teu le lisiti o le tuuina atu
email-failure-delivery-failed: Ua le manuia le tuuina atu po o le sauniuniga
email-failure-retry-limit: Ua oo i le tapulaa o taumafaiga otometi
sync-remaining-time: Fuafuaga o le taimi o totoe (itula)
sync-time-estimate-hint: O fuafuaga o le taimi e faaaoga ai fanua numera o le taimi muamua/o totoe na fausia e le faaulufale Jira. E tatau ona tasi lava le fanua fetaui i lenei laupapa. O suiga i le lotoifale e iloiloina o ni feteenaiga; o tau o le puna e misi e le amanaia ma o se null manino e faamama ai le tau.
sync-planning-hint: E faatasia Sprint ma faasalalauga na o le taimi o loo ola ai le Scrum i lenei laupapa. O se sprint po o se faasalalauga e misi e fausia i lenei laupapa, ma aso e tuuina mai e le puna; o se mea o loo i ai e faafetaui muamua i lona ID o le puna, ona sosoo ai lea ma le igoa. O se suiga o le fuafuaga i le lotoifale e tumau seia suia e le puna le fuafuaga o lena issue, ma e le aveese lava e se Sync muamua se fuafuaga.

activity-recovery-description: O faasilasilaga e lei maea e toe taumafai otometi. Iloilo gaoioiga e misi pe ua suia a o lei toe taumafai. E le toe fausia lava e le toe taumafai se gaoioiga.
activity-recovery-empty: E leai ni faasilasilaga o gaoioiga o loo faatali.
activity-recovery-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina faasilasilaga o gaoioiga o loo faatali.
activity-recovery-retrying: O loo faafou le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga…
activity-recovery-status-pending: O loo faatali le tuuina atu
activity-recovery-status-preparing: O loo faatali mo se fuafuaga o tagata e mauaina
activity-recovery-status-processing: O loo ola le faasaoina o le tuuina atu
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Faamatalaga toe faaleleia e le aoga
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: E le fetaui le fuafuaga ma le gaoioiga o loo faatali
activity-recovery-busy: O loo taulimaina e se isi tagata faigaluega lenei faasilasilaga. Faafou ma toe taumafai.
activity-recovery-denied: Ua le toe faataga e le ulufale a le tagata e mauaina po o filifiliga o faasilasilaga le tuuina atu.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Ua misi pe ua suia le gaoioiga muamua. E leai se mea na toe fausia.
activity-recovery-failed: E le mafai ona faamaea le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga. Ua teu pea galuega o loo faatali.
activity-recovery-pause: Taofi le auina atu mo sina taimi
activity-recovery-paused: Ua taofi le taimi le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga o gaoioiga.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Ua suia lenei faasilasilaga talu ona utaina. Iloilo le tulaga ua faafou a o lei toe taumafai.
activity-recovery-control-failed: E le mafai ona faamaonia le faatulagaga o le tuuina atu. Faafou ma iloilo lona tulaga o iai nei.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: Ua faalēaogāina le tuuina atu o faasilasilaga o gaoioiga.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Faalēaogā tumau le tuuina atu o totoe mo lenei gaoioiga? E le mafai ona toe faaauau. O imeli ua uma ona faatulaga ma faasilasilaga ua uma ona tuuina atu e le toe aumaia.
rule-email-recovery-description: Iloilo taumafaiga ua faamauina e lafo ai imeli a tulafono. O taumafaiga e leʻi faamaonia atonu o loo lafo pea pe na motusia. E lē toe lafoina pe faaleaogāina e lenei lipoti le lafoina.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Ua talia e le seva imeli
rule-email-recovery-invalid: E lē saʻo faamatalaga e uiga i le taumafaiga
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: Faailo o le poloaʻiga / valaauga / taumafaiga
rule-email-recovery-empty: E leai ni taumafaiga e lafo imeli a tulafono e fetaui ma lenei sailiga.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina taumafaiga imeli a tulafono. Faafou e toe taumafai.
rule-email-recovery-dropped: Ua faaleaogāina le lafoina e se pule
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: E lē toe lafoina lava e WeKan na o ia se imeli e le'i faamaonia. E toe lafo na o tagata e le'i faamaonia. Faailoga ua lafo pe afai e te iloa ua taunuu, pe faaleaogā le lafoina.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Atonu o loo faagasolo pea le lafoina muamua. E mafai ona e filifili pe a mavae le __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Toe lafo i tagata e le'i faamaonia
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Toe lafo lenei imeli i tagata e le'i faamaonia? Afai na talia e le seva meli a se tagata le imeli ae le'i logoina WeKan, o le a maua e lea tagata faalua.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Faailoga lenei imeli ua lafo i tagata uma? Fai lenei mea pe afai e te iloa ua taunuu.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Faaleaogā le lafoina o lenei imeli? O le a lē lafoina i tagata e le'i faamaonia.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Atonu o loo faagasolo pea le lafoina muamua. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Ua uma ona fo'ia lenei imeli.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Atonu o loo faagasolo pea se toe lafoina muamua. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Ua uma ona faamaonia tagata uma e mauaina. Nai lo le toe lafo, faailoga ua lafo.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: E le'i tali mai le seva meli. Atonu ua taunuu le imeli na toe lafo, pe le'i taunuu; o loo faaalia o loo faagasolo.
rule-email-resolution-busy: O loo fo'ia e se isi pule lenei imeli. Toe taumafai i se taimi puupuu.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Ua lē toe fetaui le imeli ua teuina ma lenei taumafaiga, o lea e lē mafai ona fo'ia iinei.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: E lē aogā le faamaumauga ua teuina o lenei taumafaiga, o lea e lē mafai ona fo'ia iinei.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Ua lē mafai ona fo'ia lenei imeli. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Imeli o tulafono o loo faatali mo le toe iloiloga
rule-email-legacy-description: Na saunia nei imeli o tulafono e se lomiga tuai o WeKan e le'i faamaumauina le puna o a latou mataupu, o lea e lē lafoina ai e WeKan na o ia. Siaki muamua pe o iai pea le faatagaga a le tusitala o le tulafono e maua ai le pepa, ona toe faafesoota'i lea o le imeli ina ia toe saunia mai le tulaga o le pepa i le taimi nei, pe lafoa'i.
rule-email-legacy-mail: Tagata e mauaina ma le ulutala
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Faamatalaga o le pepa mai se lomiga tuai
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Toe saunia lenei imeli mai le tulaga o le pepa i le taimi nei? Atonu e ese ana mataupu mai mea na saunia muamua.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lafoa'i lenei imeli? O le a lē lafoina lava.
rule-email-legacy-empty: E leai ni imeli o tulafono o loo faatali mo le toe iloiloga.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Ua lē mafai ona uta imeli o tulafono o loo faatali mo le toe iloiloga. Toe uta le itulau e toe taumafai ai.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Ua lē toe iai le faatagaga a le tusitala o le tulafono e maua ai lenei pepa, pe ua suia le tulafono, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Ua suia le gaoioiga na mafua ai lenei imeli, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ua lē toe maua le pepa na sau ai lenei imeli, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ua lē toe teuina le faatinoga o le tulafono na saunia ai lenei imeli, o lea e lē mafai ona toe faafesoota'i. E mafai ona e lafoa'i le imeli.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Ua uma ona lafo lenei imeli, taumafai e lafo, pe lafoa'i.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Ua uma ona toe faafesoota'i lenei imeli.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ua lē mafai ona faauma lenei gaoioiga. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Galuega List Sync e le mafai ona toe faatino
stuck-sync-operation-description: O nei galuega List Sync taitasi ua teuina na taofi i le ogatotonu ma ua le toe mafai ona faamaeaina, ona o lona lisi na aveese, toe fausia pe toe faatulaga, po o le tagata faaaoga na amataina ua leiloa lona aia e tusi ai. A o faatali se tasi, e le mafai e lena lisi ona Sync. Lafoai e faataga ai le lisi e toe Sync: o suiga ua uma ona faaaoga e tumau, o suiga ua teuina o totoe e le tusia lava, ma o le Sync e sosoo ai e toe faatusatusa le lisi ma lona puna.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Na aveese pe toe fausia le lisi pe suia ona faatulagaga Sync
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Ua le toe iai i le tagata faaaoga na amataina le aia e tusi ai i le lisi atoa
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Na teuina e se lomiga muamua o WeKan e aunoa ma le mea na amataina ai
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Ua misi le faamaumauga o le na amataina
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: E le mafai ona siaki nei
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: E mafai ona toe faatino nei ma o le a uma na o ia, o lea e le mafai ai ona lafoai.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Lafoai lenei galuega List Sync ua teuina? O suiga ua uma ona faaaoga e tumau; o isi e le tusia lava. E mafai ona toe Sync le lisi.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: E leai ni galuega List Sync o loo faatali mo se iloiloga.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: E na o mea sili ona tuai e 50 o loo faaalia. Lafoai nisi ma faafou e vaai ai i nisi.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina galuega List Sync. Faafou e toe taumafai.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Ua le toe faatali lenei galuega.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: E lei iloa ua mau lenei galuega, o lea e le mafai ai ona lafoai.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: E mafai ona toe faatino nei lenei galuega ma o le a uma na o ia, o lea e lei lafoaiina ai.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: O loo Sync lenei lisi i le taimi nei. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ua lē mafai ona faauma lenei gaoioiga. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
interrupted-import-heading: Faaulufale o laupapa na taofi a o lei maea
interrupted-import-description: O nei faaulufale o laupapa taitasi na taofi i le ogatotonu - na toe amata le server, po o le faaulufale na le manuia - ma tuu ai se laupapa vaega. E le mafai ona faaauau se faaulufale, ona e le teuina lona faila puna. Teu le laupapa e pei ona i ai, pe lafoai ma toe faaulufale le faila. O le lafoai e aveese ai le laupapa na fausia e lenei faaulufale ma mea uma o i ai, e aofia ai soo se mea na faaopoopo i ai talu mai.
interrupted-import-created: Ua fausia e oo mai nei
interrupted-import-state-stopped: Na taofi a o lei maea, i le __stage__
interrupted-import-state-failed: Na le manuia ma le __error__, i le __stage__
interrupted-import-state-discarding: O loo lafoaiina; toe lafoai e faamaea ai
interrupted-import-scrum: O lona vaega Scrum e iai lona lava siaki (__state__, __next__ o __total__ laasaga). Afai e te teuina le laupapa, faamaea pe lafoai mai le toe faaleleia o le faaulufale Scrum a le laupapa.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ ala, __lists__ lisi, __cards__ pepa, __checklists__ lisi siaki, __comments__ faamatalaga, __attachments__ faapipii
interrupted-import-no-board: E leai se laupapa na fausia
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Teu lenei laupapa vaega e pei ona i ai? E leai se mea e aveese, ma ua le toe lisiina iinei le faaulufale.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Lafoai lenei faaulufale? O le laupapa na fausia ma mea uma o i ai e aveese tumau.
interrupted-import-empty: E leai ni faaulufale o laupapa na faalavelaveina o loo faatali mo se iloiloga.
interrupted-import-truncated: E na o mea sili ona tuai e 50 o loo faaalia. Teu pe lafoai nisi ma faafou e vaai ai i nisi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: E le mafai ona utaina faaulufale o laupapa na faalavelaveina. Faafou e toe taumafai.
interrupted-import-missing: Ua le toe faamaumauina lenei faaulufale.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Ua le toe faatali lenei faaulufale mo se faaiuga.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: O le laupapa ma lenei id e lei fausia e lenei faaulufale, o lea e lei paia ai.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: O loo tusia pe toe faaleleia pea lona vaega Scrum. Toe taumafai i ni nai minute.
interrupted-import-failed: Ua lē mafai ona faauma lenei gaoioiga. Toe uta le itulau ma toe taumafai.
saml-login-not-started: E leʻi amata lenei saini i totonu i le SAML i lenei itulau o le suʻesuʻega. Faamolemole toe saini i totonu.
history-request-pending-undo: E leʻi faamaonia e le seva lau toe faaleaogāina mulimuli o se suiga.
history-request-pending-redo: E leʻi faamaonia e le seva lau toe faia mulimuli o se suiga.
history-request-hint: O le toe taumafai e toe lafo ai le talosaga lava e tasi, o lea e lē mafai ai ona faaleaogāina se suiga lona lua.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: O se toe faaleaoga, toe fai po o se toe faafoi o suiga Scrum na taofi i se feteenaiga. Ua poloka suiga Scrum i lenei laupapa seia foia.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ o __total__ suiga na tusia, __pending__ e lei tusia, ma __conflicted__ na suia e se isi talu mai.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: O le toe faafoi i tua e toe tuu ai faamaumauga uma ua suia e pei ona sa i ai muamua; e ofo mai na o le taimi e leai se isi na suia na faamaumauga talu mai. O le teuina o le laupapa e pei ona i ai e aveese ai le galuega na taofi ma e le suia ai ni faamaumauga. Soo se auala, e faamaumauina i le Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Teu le laupapa e pei ona i ai
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Teu faamaumauga uma e pei ona i ai nei, e aofia ai suiga ua uma ona tusia e le galuega na taofi?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: E mafai e se pule o le laupapa ona toe faafoi i tua pe teu le laupapa e pei ona i ai.
header-login: Ulufale e ala i ulutala HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Aveese le tau o loo teuina i le laulau a le pule
login-setting-after-restart: E amata ona aogā pe a toe amata le WeKan
login-setting-env-only: E na o le siosiomaga o le server e setiina nei mea. O loo faaalia iinei e faitau na o ia.
email-to-card-description: O se imeli e auina atu i le tuatusi o lau laupapa e avea ma pepa i lena laupapa.
email-to-card-webhook: URL o le webhook o loʻo sau mai le kamupani imeli (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark poʻo se MIME relay mata)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Ua sefe - tuu gaogao e taofi ai
email-to-card-clear-secret: Aveese le mealilo o le webhook ua sefe
email-to-card-imap-after: A uma ona faitau se imeli
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Laupapa e alu i ai imeli i lenei grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Leai - na o imeli e iai le faailoga o le laupapa i le mataupu
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Tuu lenei mea i le mataupu e oo atu ai i lenei laupapa o oe lava:
email-to-card-board-enabled: E maua imeli e lenei laupapa
email-to-card-parts: Vaega o le imeli e faaaoga
email-to-card-part-description: Tino o le imeli e fai ma faamatalaga o le pepa
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Aua le faaaofia feʻau tuai ua siiina
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Laina o le na auina mai i le pito i luga o faamatalaga
email-to-card-your-address: Lau tuatusi imeli mo lenei laupapa
email-to-card-address-private: Ia natia: soo se tasi e iai e mafai ona faaopoopo pepa e pei o oe.
email-to-card-new-address: Tuatusi fou (o le tuai o le a le toe galue)
email-to-card-member-enabled: O loʻo galue oʻu tuatusi o laupapa
email-to-card-off-admin-off: E leʻi faatulagaina le mauaina o imeli i le Laulau a le pule.
email-to-card-off-board-off: E leʻi faaolaina e se pule o le laupapa le imeli mo lenei laupapa.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Ua e tapeina au tuatusi o laupapa i Faatulagaga o Sui.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: E leʻi iai se tuatusi imeli o le grain. Toe utaina le itulau.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: E te manaʻomia le avanoa e tusi ai i lenei laupapa.
inbound-domain-invalid: E le o se igoa domeni aoga lena.
inbound-domain-required: Tuuina mai le domeni o tuatusi o laupapa.
inbound-account-invalid: E manaʻomia e se pusa meli IMAP se igoa server aoga.
feature-views-email-desc: O le laupapa o se pusameli: o le lisi imeli o le Pusa o mai, o lisi o faila, o igoa faailoga o igoa faailoga, ma tusi ma tali e sui imeli mai le tuatusi o le laupapa.
email-view-not-receiving: E le o maua e lenei laupapa ni imeli. Ki i le Faatulagaga o faasilasilaga a le laupapa → Imeli i le pepa.
email-view-invalid-address: O se tasi o tuatusi e le o se tuatusi imeli aoga.
email-view-too-many-recipients: E le sili atu i le 20 e mauaina i se feʻau.
email-view-too-many: Ua tele naua imeli ua auina atu i le itula talu ai. Toe taumafai mulimuli ane.
email-view-no-list: E manaʻomia e le laupapa se lisi mo le imeli.
email-view-send-failed: E le mafai ona auina atu le imeli.
feature-views-chat-desc: O le laupapa o se avanoa talanoaga: avanoa faigaluega, laupapa, ala, lisi ma pepa o se laau o alalaupapa, o le pepa i le ogatotonu ma ana faamatalaga o feʻau talanoaga.
chat-view-message-cards: Faʻaali na o pepa e iai feʻau
chat-view-resize: Toso e sui ai le lapoʻa
chat-view-pick-card: Filifili se pepa mai alalaupapa e vaai ai iinei.
chat-view-no-messages: E leai ni feʻau. Tusi le muamua.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: O pepa lava ia i ni seti o koluma e tele ua faaigoaina - e tusa ma le maeaina, faamuamua, maata po o se isi lava mea - e siitia i le va o koluma e ala i le toso.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → E fautua mai e Tulafono ni tulafono mai mea e faia pea e tagata i lima.
feature-board-summary-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → E faaali mai e le Aotelega mea na faia e tagata taitoatasi i le laupapa i le aso po o le vaiaso mulimuli, ma mea ua tuai.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Lisi o le laupapa → Talu mai lau asiasiga mulimuli e faaali mai mea na suia e isi i le laupapa.
feature-search-phrases-desc: E malamalama le suʻesuʻega lautele i fuaitau faigofie e pei o "oʻu kata ua tuai".
column-sets-empty: E leai ni seti koluma. E mafai e se pule o le laupapa ona faia se tasi: tuu se igoa, ona faaopoopo lea o ona koluma.
feature-views-version-control: Vaaiga o le puleaina o lomiga
feature-views-version-control-desc: O le laupapa e pei o se su'esu'ega o fa'afitauli a GitHub po'o Gitea: pepa o fa'afitauli, igoa faailoga ma fa'ailoga taua, faamatalaga o le talanoaga, faapipiiga o faila, ma le talafaasolopito o le laupapa ma le toe faaleaogaina.
vcs-no-due-date: Leai se aso e tatau ai
vcs-no-issues: Leai ni fa'afitauli e fetaui ma lenei sailiga.
vcs-no-milestones: E leai ni fa'ailoga taua i le taimi nei. O se igoa faailoga ma se aso e tatau ai o se fa'ailoga taua.
vcs-no-labels: E leai ni igoa faailoga i le taimi nei.
vcs-no-files: E leai ni faila i le taimi nei.
vcs-no-description: E leai se faamatalaga na tuuina mai.
vcs-issue-title-required: E mana'omia e se fa'afitauli se ulutala.
vcs-no-list: E leai se lisi po'o se ala o lenei laupapa mo le fa'afitauli.
card-qr-code-desc: Su'esu'e e tatala ai lenei pepa i se telefoni po'o se tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Ua umi tele le so'otaga o lenei pepa mo se fa'ailoga QR.
vcs-no-wiki: E leai se wiki. O le aumaia o se faalapotopotoga GitHub e aumai ai le wiki o se fale teu i inei.
github-org-import: Aumai i totonu se faalapotopotoga GitHub atoa
github-org-import-desc: O fale teu uma o se faalapotopotoga po o se tagata faaaoga e avea ma ana laupapa, tatala i le Board View / Version Control: o ona fa'afitauli ma a latou faamatalaga, igoa faailoga ma faila, o ona faasalalauga, o ona galuega GitHub Actions o ni Tulafono, ma lona wiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: E manaomia mo fale teu patino ma se tapulaa API maualuga. E faaaoga na o le taimi o loo faagasolo ai le aumaia ma e le teuina lava.
github-org-import-issues: Fa'afitauli, ma faamatalaga, igoa faailoga ma faila
github-org-import-release-files: Faila o faasalalauga (e mafai ona tetele)
github-org-import-actions: Galuega GitHub Actions o ni Tulafono
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Tusi le igoa o se faalapotopotoga po o se tagata faaaoga, po o lona tuatusi GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: E leai ni fale teu e aumai.
github-org-import-running: O loo faagasolo se aumaia o se faalapotopotoga.
optional-apis-desc: O REST API e foliga i API a isi tracker, ina ia mafai ai e a latou polokalama ma tusitusiga (scripts) ona faaaogā lenei WeKan e fai ma o latou backend: o mea latou te teuina e teu i WeKan, i laupapa o WeKan. E tapuni taitasi seʻia siaki iinei. E leai se tasi e iai sana aia tatau: e saini mai se client i se API token a WeKan ma e mafai ona vaai ma suia na o mea e mafai e lea tagata ona vaai ma suia i WeKan. E manaʻomia e i latou uma ona ki le WeKan REST API (WITH_API=true). O le tuatusi i lalo o taitasi o le mea lea e faaaogā e se client e fai ma ana server.
optional-api-trello-desc: O polokalama ma tusitusiga na tusia mo le REST API a Trello (mo se faataitaiga Trellinator) e galulue ma WeKan: laupapa, lisi, pepa, igoa faailoga, sui, faamatalaga ma lisi siaki. O le token a Trello o se API token a WeKan. O le tapeina o se pepa e sii ai i le teuina i WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: O client o le REST API v2 a Jira e galulue ma WeKan: o se poloketi o se laupapa (o lona ki o le ki o le laupapa), o se faafitauli o se pepa (DEV-7), o se tulaga o se lisi, ma o se suiga e siitia ai le pepa. E talia e le suʻesuʻega le JQL faigofie: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ma ORDER BY. Saini mai i se API token a WeKan e fai ma upu faalilo. O le tapeina o se faafitauli e sii ai i le teuina.
optional-api-github-desc: O client o le REST API a GitHub mo faafitauli e galulue ma WeKan: o se repository o se laupapa, o se faafitauli o se pepa, faatasi ai ma igoa faailoga, faʻailoga taua (igoa faailoga e iai le aso e tatau ai), faamatalaga, ma tatala pe tapuni e pei o Vaaiga o le Laupapa / Puleaina o lomiga. O le token o se API token a WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: O client o le REST API a Gitea ma Forgejo mo faafitauli e galulue ma WeKan, e tutusa ma le API e fetaui ma GitHub: o se repository o se laupapa ma o se faafitauli o se pepa. O le token o se API token a WeKan.
bots-none: E leai ni robots. O le robot o se tagata faʻatino i lau lava server - o se sui AI, o se galuega CI, o se tusitusiga - e tuʻuina atu i ai e lenei laupapa pepa.
bots-no-runs: E leai se robot o loʻo galue nei.
bots-summary: %s o loʻo faia · %s o loʻo faatali mo oe
r-dispatch-bot: Tuʻu le pepa i le robot
bot-not-found: E le o i luga o lenei laupapa lena robot.
bot-option-not-found: E le o se tali lena na ofoina mai e le robot.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: E le mafai e Webhooks e Auina Atu ona oo atu i tuatusi i luga o le fesoʻotaʻiga a WeKan lava ia, ina ia le mafai e se tasi ona faasino le webhook a se laupapa i se auaunaga i totonu. Lisi iinei 'host' i luga o lena fesoʻotaʻiga e mafai ona oo atu i ai webhooks - se Node-RED, se 'server' talanoa - tasi i le laina, o se igoa po o se tuatusi, faatasi ma se 'port' e faataga ai na o lena 'port'. Avanoa: leai se mea. Na o Pule o le saite e mafai ona suia lenei lisi.
account-webhook: Webhook mo le ulufale ma le resitala
account-webhook-desc: O le tuatusi e tasi e logo i ai WeKan pe a ulufale se tasi pe faia se akaunia fou. E leai se mea e auina atu seia faailoga se mea e tupu i lalo. E aveina le mea na tupu, le igoa o le tagata faaaoga ma le taimi; faailoga isi vaega pe a manaomia e le tagata e mauaina.
account-webhook-on-register: Pe a faia se akaunia fou
account-webhook-field-ip: Tuatusi IP na sau ai le ulufale
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: E le o se host, e le'i teuina:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Faalēaogā uma faasilasilaga o loo faatali mo gaoioiga e sili atu ona tuai nai lo le fia aso?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Ua faalēaogāina %s, ua tuuina atu %s, %s tuai o loo faatali pea.
vcs-synced-from: Ua fa'atasi mai %s: tatala ma tapuni iina.
vcs-synced-issue: O lenei fa'afitauli ua fa'atasia: tatala ma tapuni i lona polokalame su'esu'e.
sync-write-back: Toe tusi suiga i GitLab: ulutala, fa'amatalaga, manatu, tapunia ma toe tatalaina
sync-write-back-error: Na le manuia le toe tusi i GitLab
email-bounces-description: O le mea e fai e WeKan i imeli e toe foʻi mai: o se tuatusi na sese le taina, o se pusa meli ua tumu, o se tali e le o iai i le ofisa, o se faitioga o le spam. O ituaiga taitasi e iai a latou lava gaioiga, e faia pe a toe foʻi mai i na taimi.
email-bounces-enabled: Puleaina imeli toe foʻi mai i le WeKan
email-bounces-threshold: Pe a uma ni taimi se fia
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Taofi le lafoina o imeli i le tuatusi
email-bounces-action-notify-inviter: Taʻu atu i lē na valaʻaulia
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: E le o iai le tuatusi: o se mea sese i le taina, o se teugatupe ua tapeina, o se domain e le iloa.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: E leʻi ausia mo le taimi nei: ua tumu le pusa meli, ua pisi le server. Na o le tele soso o loʻo iai se uiga.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Tali o le le i ai i le ofisa, malologa poʻo le faiga o tiketi. Na ausia le imeli.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Na faailoga e le na mauaina le imeli o se spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: I le Amazon SES, lafo atu faasilasilaga Bounce ma Complaint, ma se tulafono o le mauaina mo le tuatusi e lafo mai ai le WeKan, i se autu SNS, ma lesitala lenei tuatusi i ai e ala i le HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN o autu SNS e talia, tasi i le laina
email-bounces-stopped-only: Na o tuatusi e le toe lafoina i ai imeli e le WeKan
email-bounces-clear-hint: Faagalo le toe foʻi mai o lenei tuatusi ma toe lafo i ai imeli
email-bounce-invalid-topic: E le o se ARN o se autu SNS lena.
email-bounces-providers-description: Afai e lafo e WeKan e ala i se tasi o nei auaunaga, ki ai, tuu atu i le auaunaga lenei tuatusi webhook mo ana mea e tutupu o imeli na toe foʻi mai ma faitioga o le spam, ma faapipii iinei le ki e sainia ai, po o le upu faataga na e tuuina i le tuatusi e pei o https://user:password@… po o ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: O se auaunaga ua ki e manaʻomia lana ki saini po o le upu faataga.
activity-pub-enabled: O laupapa faitele e lolomi ai a latou gaoioiga o pepa i le fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: E tapuni i le amataga. A ki, e mafai ona mulimuli i laupapa faitele taitasi mai Mastodon ma isi 'auʻaunaga fediverse e pei o @board-<id> i le tuatusi o lenei WeKan, ma o gaoioiga fou o pepa e oo atu i e mulimuli ai. E faitau na o le pau: e leai se mea e auina mai e se ʻauʻaunaga fediverse e suia ai se laupapa, ma e le lolomiina lava laupapa tumaoti.
caldav-sync-desc: Tuu aso e tatau ai o pepa o lenei laupapa i se kalena - Nextcloud Calendar po o soo se kalena CalDAV. O se aso e tatau ai ua siitia i le kalena e toe foi mai i le pepa. Faaaoga se upu faataga o le polokalama, ae le o lau lava upu faataga.
caldav-enabled: Faatasi aso e tatau ai ma lenei kalena
caldav-invalid-url: O le tuatusi o le kalena e tatau ona avea ma tuatusi http:// po o https://, e aunoa ma se igoa o le tagata faaaoga po o se upu faataga i totonu.
caldav-not-linked: Sefe muamua se tuatusi o le kalena ma ki le faatasiga.
webdav-storage-description: Teu faapipiiga i se faila i luga o se ʻauʻaunaga WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud po o soo se isi. Faaaoga se upu faataga o le polokalama na faia mo WeKan. E mafai ona faaaoga iinei se ʻauʻaunaga i luga o le fesootaiga a WeKan lava ia, aua e na o le pule o le saite e seti lenei tuatusi.
sqrl-enabled: Saini i totonu i le SQRL
sqrl-desc: Tapē e masani ai. A ki, e ofoina e le itulau saini i totonu le SQRL, ma e muamua ona faaopoopo e sui lo latou faasinomaga SQRL i Faatulagaga a le Sui. E manaomia e le SQRL le WeKan i se tuatusi https://.
sqrl-sign-in: Saini i totonu i le SQRL
sqrl-scan: Su'esu'e le koti i lau polokalame SQRL, pe tatala lau kalani SQRL i lenei masini.
sqrl-expired: Ua uma le taimi o lenei koti SQRL. Toe amata.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: Ua lē manuia le saini i totonu i le SQRL.
sqrl-needs-https: E manaomia e le SQRL le WeKan i se tuatusi https://.
sqrl-description: Saini i totonu i lou faasinomaga SQRL nai lo se upu faataga. Faaopoopo iinei faatasi i lau kalani SQRL; e mafai ona e aveese iinei i soo se taimi.
sqrl-none: E leai se faasinomaga SQRL ua faaopoopo.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Ua tapē le saini i totonu i le SQRL mo lenei teugatupe mai lau kalani SQRL. Toe ki iina i lau koti laveai.
sqrl-only-on: Ua loka e lau kalani SQRL lenei teugatupe i le SQRL na o ia: ua teena isi auala uma e saini ai i totonu.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Ua loka mausali e lau kalani SQRL lenei teugatupe: ua teena le toe setiina o le upu faataga ma le suiina o le imeli.
sqrl-only: O lenei teugatupe e saini i totonu i le SQRL na o ia.
sqrl-hardlock: Ua loka lenei teugatupe i le SQRL: e le mafai ona toe maua pe suia i se isi lava auala.
windows-sso-sign-in: Saini i totonu i le Windows
windows-sso-failed: Ua lē manuia le saini i totonu i le Windows. Atonu e lē faatagaina lau tala Windows iinei.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: Leai ni poloka e tutusa na maua
